verdict.rationale: Termius documents an AI feature that turns a plain-language description into a shell command, so users can drive terminal work with natural language. Nothing shows natural language controlling Termius itself: connecting to hosts, managing vaults, port forwarding or workspaces. The evidence is a single first-party doc mention with no community or hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: natural-language control of the app's own features (hosts, vaults, forwarding, workspaces), agentic multi-step execution, in-depth documentation of the AI feature's scope and limits, independent corroboration.
